description: This file provides utility functions for sorting and grouping Note objects in the frontend of a note-organizing application. It exports functions to sort notes based on different modes ('updated', 'created', 'title') and to separate pinned notes from others.

methods.name: export function sortNotes(notes: Note[], mode: SortMode = 'updated'): Note[] { sortNotes
methods.description: Sorts an array of Note objects based on the specified mode ('updated', 'created', 'title'). Pinned notes are prioritized when sorting by 'updated'.

methods.name: export function groupPinned(notes: Note[]): { pinned: Note[]; others: Note[] } { groupPinned
methods.description: Splits an array of notes into pinned notes and non-pinned notes, returning an object with both groups.

ctags.name: groupPinned
ctags.pattern: /^export function groupPinned(notes: Note[]): { pinned: Note[]; others: Note[] } {$/

ctags.name: sortNotes
ctags.pattern: /^export function sortNotes(notes: Note[], mode: SortMode = 'updated'): Note[] {$/
